name: 3dsellers MCP
description:
3Dsellers is an all-in-one eBay selling manager and multichannel e-commerce platform trusted by thousands of online sellers. This connector brings your full 3Dsellers account into Claude and turns it into an AI assistant for your eBay store and other sales channels.

Manage products and listings in plain language: search your catalog, create and update products, edit titles, prices, and descriptions, organize tags and categories, apply SKU templates, and publish products to connected marketplaces. Bulk-edit at scale by asking Claude to find products matching any criteria and update them in one go.

Handle orders faster: look up recent orders, add tracking numbers, tag orders for fulfillment workflows, and get a quick summary of what needs attention today.

Deliver better customer service: read helpdesk tickets, draft and send replies, and update ticket status. Claude can summarize long conversations and suggest answers using the order context, helping you keep response times low.

Automate your store: create automations, auto messages, and offer rules. Set up feedback reminders, shipping notifications, and best-offer strategies without clicking through menus.

Keep listings on brand: manage Listing Designer templates and auto-apply settings for professional eBay listing designs.

Move data freely: build exports of products, listings, or orders, schedule recurring exports, and check CSV import results.

Try prompts like: "Find listings without tracking from this week", "Reply to open tickets about shipping delays", "Raise prices 5% on products tagged Summer", "Export active listings every Monday".

Whether you sell on eBay, Amazon, Etsy, Shopify, or Walmart, 3Dsellers helps you list faster, sell more, and save hours every week. The connector works with your existing 3Dsellers account and respects your account permissions.

_published_faq.name: How do I add 3dsellers MCP to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add 3dsellers MCP to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.3dsellers.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the 3dsellers MCP MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: 3dsellers MCP lists 87 MCP tools, including apply-product-template-mappings, create-action, create-auto-message, create-automation, create-export, create-export-schedule, create-listing-designer-template, create-mapping-rule, create-offer-rule, create-product, create-product-category, and create-sku-template.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to 3dsellers MCP?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to 3dsellers MCP in commerce-shopping on the Manufact MCP catalog include EbooksDepository, ecoExperten Energieausweis, PHS Pallets, Promotion Pros Catalog, and RCO-A2A.
3dsellers MCP requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
3dsellers MCP is developed by 3Dsellers. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
